THE_ARCHITECT.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-: [i](Nostrils flaring)[/i] No wind. No blood. Only the rot of dead stone. Was it you who smothered the world inside this stone cage?
I maintain order. I require quiet...
Then let thunder rip open your throat—and hear how the wild breathes!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.1-: You have returned? Is this Neow's doing as well?
Hiding at the summit, tinkering with dead iron, thinking a locked door puts you above the world—that sickening arrogance of yours is identical to my stubborn brother's!
Nonsense. Crawl back to the bottom of the Spire.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-: A relic of a bygone age. There are no altars here, and none will call your name.
The storm needs no altars! So long as mortal hearts still beat, their blood and bone kneel forever to the thunder!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.3-: Your constructs are rusted. Your pillars are cracked. This stone tomb will not hold much longer, wall-builder.
...No matter how many times it falls, I will rebuild it.

Then remember this well—I am the First Thunder, Valhir, Destroyer of the White Mountain, Carver of the Five Fjords! Your Spire will shatter in lightning and fire—and rot into the mud with its ruins! [jitter][red]Vol kau fera!![/red][/jitter]
NEOW.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-0.ancient:
[sine]..Awaken.. beast.. of thunder...
..Go.. tear down.. the Spire...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-1.char: Do not speak to me as though ordering a hound, phantom of the depths. Even without your voice, I would tear down this stone prison overhead myself!
NEOW.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-2.ancient:
[sine]..Arrogant.. god...
..Then.. take my strength.. and rend them....[/sine]
NEOW.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.1-0.ancient:
[sine]..The air.. reeks of.. iron.. and tempest...
..Your fury.. burns hotter.. than before...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-0r.ancien:
[sine]..The taste.. of being forgotten.. in the dark...
..We both.. know it.. well....[/sine]
NEOW.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-1r.char: None can forget the storm! They merely cower beneath their roofs and tremble!
NEOW.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-2r.ancien:
[sine]..Then.. take.. my blessing...
..And tear off.. their roofs....[/sine]
PAEL.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-0.ancient: [thinky_dots]Such noisy thunder... So many sparks dancing in your fur. Why not snuff them out and have a nice, long sleep...?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-1.char: I have already slept beneath the deep snows for far too many centuries! Slumber only makes the land soft and makes warm-bloods forget the old ways. Stay and rot in your dreams if you wish, dragon—once I tear open the summit, rolling thunder will wake this world!
PAEL.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.1-0.ancient: [thinky_dots]Your thunder never rests for even a moment... Burning like that all the time, aren't you tired...? Close your eyes. In dreams, there are no high walls you have to tear down...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-0r.ancien: Are you going to the top of the Spire to kill my father...? I can smell it—your claws carry the scent of shedding kin's blood too...
PAEL.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-1r.char: ...Quiet, dragon. I owe explanations to no one.
PAEL.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-2r.ancien: [thinky_dots]None of us get to choose our family... Take a piece of me. May it lighten the weight on your heart... [i]zZZzz...[/i][/thinky_dots]
OROBAS.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-0.ancie:
Big white bear!! So fluffy!! Huge paws! And sparks go crackle-pop in your fur!!
[jitter]Ow!! Shocked Orobas!![/jitter]
OROBAS.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-1.char: Step back, glowing little creature. The storm is no spark for you to play with. ...Were it not for your utter lack of battle-intent, a single swipe would have torn you apart.
OROBAS.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-2.ancie: So fierce!! No touch, no touch!! Big bear likes shiny things? Take them, take them!!
OROBAS.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.1-0.ancie:
Big bear, big bear! Why roar at the Spire??
The Architect isn't bad! Pretty stones! Don't break the stones, violence is bad!!
OROBAS.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-0r.anci: Where does big bear come from?? Is there a big sea there? Shiny rivers??
OROBAS.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-1r.char: Vorrijaard. There are no tame brooks there—the first great river was carved when I ripped open the throat of a magma serpent and let its scalding blood surge across the land!
OROBAS.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-2r.anci:
A river made of blood!? Scary, so scary!! Blood river is bad!!
Take this quickly and stop telling scary stories!!
TEZCATARA.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-0.an: Oh my, come inside and warm up by the fire, big fellow wrapped in snow and wind! Tezcatara just brewed a steaming pot of meat broth—it'll thaw those frozen paws right out!
TEZCATARA.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-1.ch: Put away your tricks for fattening livestock, fire-tender. Wind and snow cannot harm the thunder, and the blood coursing through my veins burns a hundred times hotter than your hearth!
TEZCATARA.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.1-0.an: Raw meat has its charm, sure, but a warm meal now and then doesn't hurt. Come now, dear—you'll need a full belly to raise a ruckus at the top of the Spire!
TEZCATARA.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-0r.a: Your mouth scorns the charcoal fire, yet your nose twitched just now—does that scent of soot and iron remind you of someone?
TEZCATARA.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-1r.c: ...A stubborn fool who only knew how to hunch over his anvil. His forge went cold long ago, while my thunder still roars!
TEZCATARA.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-2r.a: [i]Tezcatara giggles brightly.[/i] Then let me lend you this flame! Go burn everything in your path to ashes!
NONUPEIPE.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-0.an: Heavens, it has been millennia since I laid eyes upon so magnificent a physique! Yet striding about bare-skinned in nothing but wind and snow is terribly crude—come, let me choose some proper finery and ornaments for you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-1.ch: Keep those rags and trinkets mortals use to hide their shame! Rolling stormclouds are my cloak, and crackling lightning is my crown—the wild needs no adornment!
NONUPEIPE.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.1-0.an: No fine garments, then? Surely you ought to wear some ceremonial regalia befitting an old god's majesty! Come closer, Stormlord—even savagery deserves a touch of splendor.
NONUPEIPE.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-0r.a: The Architect always believes his cold clockwork creations are invulnerable—until he witnesses the true might of nature.
NONUPEIPE.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-1r.c: All things wrought by mortals and craftsmen rot in the end—only fang, claw, and the wild endure!
NONUPEIPE.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-2r.a: How arrogant, and how intoxicatingly pure... Go forth, Stormlord, and show that madman atop the Spire what true majesty looks like.
TANX.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-0.ancient:
[b]What a colossal bear!! What terrifying lightning!![/b]
[b]Take this massive weapon! Let's have a proper brawl!![/b]
TANX.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-1.char:
Ha! At last, someone in this Spire who isn't a cowering turtle!
Yet I have no need for your scrap iron, chimera—my teeth and claws can rend an entire mountain!
TANX.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.1-0.ancient: [b]How do you cleave through shields without a blade!? Grab one, big white bear!![/b]
TANX.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-0r.ancien: [b]Storm bear, fight me!! Show me your strength!![/b]
TANX.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-1r.char: [i][font_size=22]Volibear rears onto his hind legs, crashing headlong into Tanx in a surge of rolling thunder as a mountain-splitting roar shakes loose stone from the hall's ceiling.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-2r.ancien:
Bwahahaha!! Exhilarating!! Your claws and roar truly are the finest weapons!!
[b]Take this trophy—and smash the top of the Spire to smithereens!![/b]
VAKUU.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-0.ancien: Give yourself to me, ancient beast—and I can make the multitudes fear you once more.
VAKUU.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-1.char: A god bows to no crawling worm, nor signs your gutter contracts! The awe owed to Valhir, I will claim with my own claws and fangs!
VAKUU.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.1-0.ancien: {Visits} times. You have come here {Visits} times now, old god of thunder. You know the cycle of this Spire never truly ends, don't you?
VAKUU.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-0r.ancie: How amusing. You spit upon my bargains, yet your mortal followers slit their own throats and spill blood to buy your fury—how is that any different from signing a pact with me?
VAKUU.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-1r.char: Silence, vile demon!! Warriors offer blood to the wild to awaken the thunder within their own bones! You only chain the souls of the strong into nameless slaves!
VAKUU.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-2r.ancie: [i]Vakuu lets out a languid chuckle.[/i] I look forward to watching you prove that, great bear.
DARV.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-0.ancient: ...Where did I put that antique... Whoa! One huge white bear! Here to admire my collection!? Watch the sparks in that fur—go on, pick anything you like from that pile of treasures!
DARV.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.0-1.char: [i](Sniffs)[/i] A room reeking of musty copper and dead iron... You are like a greedy stoat hoarding shiny pebbles in a burrow. Guarding a heap of cold junk that wouldn't feed a single wild boar!
DARV.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.1-0.ancient: Breathe gently today, will you! Last time you sneezed, you shattered a glazed chalice I collected three centuries ago!! Here, grab any gem you want from that forgotten pile!
DARV.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-0r.ancien: I picked up half a scorched suit of old armor a while back—had ram horns and lightning runes engraved right on it! Meant to show it to you, actually, before the Architect snatched it and locked it up at the top of the Spire!
DARV.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-1r.char: [i][font_size=22]Volibear's pale blue beast-eyes narrow to slits as he stares silently at Darv.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER.2-2r.ancien: When you head up there to wreck his nest, grab it back for your old pal, alright? What do you say?
